pages.title: Getting Results Back
pages.content: Use the `return` keyword to send a value back from a function. The function stops executing after a `return` statement. You can store the returned value in a variable.

pages.title: Return Statement
pages.content: Return values make functions much more powerful:
pages.code:
def square(n):
    return n * n

result = square(4)
print(result)     # 16

# Use directly
print(square(7))  # 49
